summary: This page was rendered by document_pipeline.py from content.sample.json. One content file in, a design-frozen PDF out — the same engine renders the CV this repo is linked from. If this document ever overflows one page, the build fails on purpose.

how.heading: How it works
how.headline: content file → HTML → headless Chrome → one-page PDF
bullets: The content file owns every word; the design is frozen in one CSS block.
A variant file deep-merges over the core — dicts merge deep, lists replace whole.
**bold** renders as emphasis, <m>muted</m> renders as metadata — the only markup allowed.

rules.heading: Design rules
bullets: One page is a hard gate, not a guideline — overflow exits non-zero.
Content changes and design changes never travel in the same edit.
A stale PDF is never reported as fresh output.

lines.label: --variant
lines.text: deep-merge a variant file over the core content

lines.text: render to a temp dir and report the page count only
